title: Better Calibrated, Better Planned: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-ASV Informative Path Planning for Oil Spill Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2611.21783v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Monitoring oil spills with fleets of Autonomous Surface Vehicles (ASVs) requires mapping a heterogeneous pollutant field from sparse, noisy measurements under tight time and energy budgets. Informative Path Planning (IPP) addresses this problem by coupling a reconstruction model, which infers the field and its uncertainty, with a planner that decides where to sample next. Prior work has focused on planning strategies and has largely relied on Gaussian Processes (GPs), leaving the calibration of the model's uncertainty underexplored. We study how uncertainty calibration conditions multi-vehicle IPP with a fleet of ASVs that coordinates online through a shared uncertainty map. We introduce Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) as an uncertainty-calibrated information model. translated_title: 更好的校准，更好的规划：面向石油泄漏监测的不确定性感知多自主水面航行器（ASV）信息路径规划
translated_abstract: 使用自主水面航行器（ASV）编队监测石油泄漏，需要在紧迫的时间和能量预算下，基于稀疏且含噪声的测量数据对非均质的污染物场进行重建。信息路径规划（IPP）通过将推断场及其不确定性的重建模型与决定下一步采样位置的规划器相耦合来解决这一问题。以往的工作主要聚焦于规划策略，并大量依赖高斯过程（GP），而对模型不确定性的校准则研究不足。我们研究了不确定性校准如何影响多航行器IPP，其中一组ASV通过共享的不确定性地图进行在线协同。我们引入证据深度学习（EDL）作为经不确定性校准的信息模型。在基于物理的石油泄漏仿真中，我们在闭环环境下将EDL、蒙特卡洛Dropout和深度集成与GP进行对比，并结合五种规划器进行基准测试。在60张地图上，对……的选择（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文将证据深度学习（EDL）引入作为经不确定性校准的信息模型，研究不确定性校准对多ASV协同信息路径规划的影响，证明模型校准质量直接决定石油泄漏监测的规划效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Evidential Deep Learning as an uncertainty-calibrated information model and shows that uncertainty calibration critically conditions multi-ASV informative path planning performance for oil spill monitoring.
